messages:
rahul: Heads up — Brightline's security team asked for evidence that a recent RBAC change did NOT grant our service-account (svc-inference) KMS decrypt permissions. They want: audit-chain, SIEM export, and key-use proofs for the last 90 days. What's the fastest set of deliverables?

liz: We can produce: 1) RBAC change PR + reviewer list, 2) IAM policy diff, 3) KMS access logs (CloudTrail) + exported JSON, 4) SIEM search query and results snapshot. All low-effort.

sophie: + runbook note: we should also include a signed statement from the oncall that no manual key operations occurred during that window. Customer cares about human vs service access.

kevin: For KMS key-use proof, easiest is CloudTrail query:
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01 --start-time 2023-11-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-02-29T23:59:59Z > kms-lookup.json
```
We should filter for "Decrypt" / "GenerateDataKey" events.

rahul: Are there any RBAC corner-cases where a role binding to svc-inference could implicitly allow KMS envelope decrypt via a different role? I thought we scoped service roles to compute-only.

liz: We scoped compute roles to kms:Encrypt only for envelope use; decrypt is pinned to key rotation jobs + ops service-account. The PR that changed RBAC earlier swapped a role assignment on namespace 'dedicated-pt' — that PR changed a rolebinding for svc-inference -> role "inference-worker". Need to attach the PR link and the role yaml.

devon: I'll attach the role diff and the audit_log_export. Note: there was a transient deploy failure on 2024-01-06 that triggered a fallback which briefly used the ops service-account to rerun some batches. Need to mark that and show it didn't touch KMS keys.

sec-bot: Automated check: RBAC change PR #4821 does not include kms:Decrypt in role "inference-worker". Static analysis: PASS.

kevin: For SIEM we can export Splunk query + timeframe. Quick query:
```splunk
index=cloudtrail source="aws:kms" (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) key_id="abcd-ef01" | stats count by userIdentity.arn, eventName, _time
```
We should capture the last 90 days and attach a csv.

sophie: Vulnerability note — pen test flagged an IAM elevation path via a stale service-account token exchange that was mitigated in rolling 2024-01-20 patch. We should include the triage doc and the remediation PR. Customer will want timeline + proof of re-test.

rahul: Good call. Also they asked for an incident-response contact and evidence of our evidence-handling chain (hashes of exported logs). Can we produce signed hashes?

ir-oncall: Yes — we publish signed manifest hashes for evidence bundles. I can produce a manifest: sha256 sums + sig by our IR key. Will include timestamped GPG sig and paste into the bundle. Also propose: we upload to pre-signed S3 with expiry and provide URL.

liz: Proposed deliverables list (minimal):
- PR link + role yaml diff (confirmed no kms:Decrypt)
- CloudTrail KMS export (JSON) for key abcd-ef01 covering 90d + sha256 + GPG sig
- SIEM CSV of Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events + Splunk query used
- Pen-test triage doc + remediation PR + retest evidence
- IR manifest + signed hashes + pre-signed download link
- Short cover letter summarizing timeline and who attested (names)

devon: I can assemble the bundle. ETA today EOD if no blockers. I'll also redact any customer PII.

rahul: Thanks. Can we also include a short note about our key policy: default denies Decrypt to general compute roles, explicit allowance only to ops-key-rotation role and the HSM gateway. That usually calms auditors.

kevin: I'll attach a snippet of the key policy and the key-grant audit. Example snippet:
```json
{"Sid":"AllowOpsRotate","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ops-key-rotation"},"Action":["kms:CreateGrant","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"]}
```
Make sure to obfuscate ARNs before sharing externally.

sec-bot: Evidence bundle created: s3://evidence-prod/brightline/4876543210-bundle.tar.gz (pre-signed URL expires in 7 days). Manifest: 2a7f...c9b1 (sha256).

rahul: Perfect. @liz @devon @ir-oncall please confirm attachments and I'll send to Brightline security with the cover note.

liz: Confirmed — I uploaded role-diff.pdf and cover-note.md to the bundle.

devon: Confirmed — CloudTrail JSON + SIEM csv uploaded.

ir-oncall: Confirmed — GPG-signed manifest uploaded and key fingerprint included.

rahul: Sending now. Will post copy of the outgoing email here. :thumbsup:
